### Active Members {#active-members}

**`r fmt_n(active_now$active_count)`** out of **`r fmt_n(active_now$total_user_count)`** users were active, which is **`r fmt_pct(active_now$prop_active * 100)`** of the community. The target for this indicator is set as **≥ `r round(cfg$target_active * 100)`%**.

The proportion of active members reflects users who logged in **at least once within the past `r cfg$active_days` days**, based on weekly snapshots. Members who have not logged in during that `r cfg$active_days`-day window are considered inactive (dormant or uninterested).

```{r}
#| label: active-members-trend
#| fig-height: 4

# Recent weeks only
active_kpi_plot <- kpi_weekly %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - cfg$trend_window_days)

# Plot
ggplot(active_kpi_plot, aes(x = week, y = prop_active)) +
  geom_line(color = collab$brand, size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = collab$brand, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Active Members",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(max(active_kpi_plot$week))}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = expansion(add = c(7, 7))  # padding on both sides
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  theme_collab_line()

```

### Posting Activity {#posting-act}

**`r fmt_pct(latest_kpi$posting)`** of members posted at least once in the most recent month.

Posting activity tracks sustained member interaction with the platform by measuring the proportion of users who post at least once per month through Collaboratory channels.

```{r}
#| label: posting-activity-trend
#| fig-height: 4
# Recent weeks only
posting_kpi_plot <- monthly_posters_kpi %>%
  arrange(week) %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - cfg$trend_window_days)

# Plot
ggplot(posting_kpi_plot, aes(x = week, y = prop_active_posters)) +
  geom_line(color = collab$brand, size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = collab$brand, size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Posting Activity",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(max(posting_kpi_plot$week))}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    date_labels = "%b %Y",
    date_breaks = "1 month",
    expand = expansion(add = c(7, 7))  # padding on both sides
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
  labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
  limits = c(
    floor(min(posting_kpi_plot$prop_active_posters) * 1000) / 1000,
    ceiling(max(posting_kpi_plot$prop_active_posters) * 1000) / 1000
  ),
  expand = expansion(mult = c(0.1, 0.15))
) +
  theme_collab_line()
```

The volume of posts, likes, and topics reflects total community activity over time.

```{r}
#| label: monthly-activity-chart
#| fig-height: 4
# Filter out NA rows
plot_data <- combined_monthly %>% filter(!is.na(Month))

# Define legend order
legend_order <- c("Topics", "Posts", "Likes")

# Plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Total_Topics, color = factor("Topics", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Total_Topics, color = factor("Topics", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Total_Posts, color = factor("Posts", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Total_Posts, color = factor("Posts", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Total_Likes, color = factor("Likes", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Total_Likes, color = factor("Likes", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly User Activity",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {fmt_date(forum_stats_date)}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Topics" = collab$brand, "Posts" = collab$cat0, "Likes" = collab$cat1),
    breaks = legend_order
  ) +
  theme_collab_line("bottom")
```

```{r}
#| label: cumulative-activity-chart
#| fig-height: 4
# Compute cumulative values
cumulative_data <- combined_monthly %>%
  arrange(Month) %>%
  mutate(
    Cumulative_Topics = cumsum(Total_Topics),
    Cumulative_Posts = cumsum(Total_Posts),
    Cumulative_Likes = cumsum(Total_Likes)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Month))

# Define legend order
legend_order <- c("Topics", "Posts", "Likes")

# Plot
ggplot(cumulative_data, aes(x = Month)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative_Topics, color = factor("Topics", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative_Topics, color = factor("Topics", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative_Posts, color = factor("Posts", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative_Posts, color = factor("Posts", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Cumulative_Likes, color = factor("Likes", levels = legend_order)), size = 1) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Cumulative_Likes, color = factor("Likes", levels = legend_order)), size = 2) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative User Activity",
    subtitle = glue::glue("As of {fmt_date(forum_stats_date)}"),
    x = "",
    y = ""
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_labels = "%b %Y", date_breaks = "2 months") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Topics" = collab$brand, "Posts" = collab$cat0, "Likes" = collab$cat1),
    breaks = legend_order
  ) +
  theme_collab_line("bottom")
```

### Engagement {#engagement}

Monthly engagement metrics provide an overview of user activity on the forum. These include total and new user counts, along with averages for user activity.Users are classified by recency of activity:

-   **Active**: last seen within `r cfg$active_days` days
-   **Dormant**: last seen `r cfg$active_days + 1`–`r cfg$dormant_days` days ago
-   **Uninterested**: last seen more than `r cfg$dormant_days` days ago

Engagement intensity is assessed based on the average time a user spends reading per month, normalized by account age, enabling comparison across all users. Based on this measure, users are categorized as:

-   **Highly Engaged**: `r cfg$engagement_high` or more minutes per month
-   **Moderately Engaged**: between `r cfg$engagement_moderate` and `r cfg$engagement_high` minutes per month
-   **Barely Engaged**: less than `r cfg$engagement_moderate` minutes per month

::: panel-tabset
#### Engagement Metrics {#engagement-metrics}

All figures reflect month-over-month changes to support interpretation of longer-term trends. Note that the monthly change for activity and engagement reflects increases or decreases in absolute numbers, and does not indicate changes in their proportional share of the user base.

```{r}
#| label: table-engagement-metrics
tables_all$metrics %>% kable_monthly("Average activity per member")
```

```{r}
#| label: table-activity-groups
tables_all$activity %>% kable_monthly("Members by activity")
```

```{r}
#| label: table-engagement-levels
tables_all$engagement %>% kable_monthly("Members by engagement level")
```

### Engagement Levels {#eng-levels}

```{r}
#| label: engagement-levels-prep
# Recent weeks only, with readable level names
engagement_recent <- engagement_weekly %>%
  filter(week >= max(week) - cfg$trend_window_days) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(
      recode(level, High = "Highly engaged", Moderate = "Moderately engaged", Barely = "Barely engaged"),
      levels = c("Barely engaged", "Moderately engaged", "Highly engaged")
    ),
    ratio = share
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: engagement-levels-chart
#| fig-height: 2

# Step 5: Horizontal stacked bar chart for latest week
latest_week <- max(engagement_recent$week)
engagement_latest <- engagement_recent %>%
  filter(week == latest_week) %>%
  mutate(
    prop_percent = ratio * 100,
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c("Highly engaged", "Moderately engaged", "Barely engaged"))
  )

level_fills <- c(
  "Barely engaged"     = collab$brand,
  "Moderately engaged" = collab$cat0,
  "Highly engaged"     = collab$cat1
)

bar_chart <- ggplot(engagement_latest, aes(x = 1, y = prop_percent, fill = Category)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.3, color = "white") +
  coord_flip() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(prop_percent, 1), "%"), group = Category,
                color = label_color(level_fills[as.character(Category)])),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = collab_size$label) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0, 100), labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = level_fills) +
  labs(
    title = "Engagement Levels – Latest Week",
    subtitle = glue("As of {fmt_date(snapshot_date)}"),
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = ""
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE)) +
  theme_collab_bar()

bar_chart
```

### Collaborative Resources and Repositories

Members share resources and tools through Collaboratory, highlighting collaboration and the exchange of knowledge within the community.

```{r}
#| label: repository-figures
#| results: asis
# Figures come from data/manual/repositories.csv (columns: group, metric, value)
repo_metrics <- read_manual("repositories")
if (is.null(repo_metrics)) {
  cat("Repository figures are not available for this period.\n")
} else {
  for (g in unique(repo_metrics$group)) {
    rows <- repo_metrics[repo_metrics$group == g, ]
    cat("\n##### ", g, "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat(paste0("-   ", rows$metric, ": ", rows$value), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n")
  }
}
```

Note: Counts may include overlaps across repositories.
